narrative_order: Villa → Summons → Order → Last Hours → Hand → Paulina → Seneca → Bath → Empty Room
notes: The preview uses scene 04. Gallery shows all nine images once in chronological/artistic sequence. Four brief Latin extracts from Tacitus are interleaved, with English editorial translations. Source letters on scene 03 are pictorial invention, not authentic Latin.

frames.title: The Villa
frames.alt: The imagined Roman villa at dusk, monumental colonnades and a few figures approaching.

frames.title: The Summons
frames.alt: Roman soldiers ascend a broad flight of stairs toward a glowing doorway.

frames.title: The Order
frames.alt: An imagined Roman inscription illuminated by fire beside shadowed figures.

frames.title: The Last Hours
frames.alt: The seated philosopher surrounded by witnesses in a monumental dark chamber, a bronze basin in the foreground.

frames.title: The Hand
frames.alt: A close view of Seneca's outstretched hand suspended above a vessel in warm darkness.

frames.title: Paulina
frames.alt: A reclining woman in pale fabric attended by three people in a very dark Roman room.

frames.title: Seneca
frames.alt: A gaunt elderly man's face and upper body emerge softly from the darkness.

frames.title: The Bath
frames.alt: A figure raises an arm from a steaming bath in a dimly glowing Roman interior.

frames.title: The Empty Room
frames.alt: The Roman hall after the event, emptied of people, with a bronze basin, white drapery and distant cold blue light.
